ns2:course.label: Advanced Data Visualization
ns2:course.description: This seminar-style course will cover advanced topics in visualization techniques. This will cover topics such as the history of visualization techniques, the perception and understanding of visual information, and new frontiers in displaying quantitative information. We will explore the modern technical stack for creating and sharing visualizations, including topics in javascript, python, and reactive frameworks. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences or Illinois Informatics Institute department.
